tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Only the manufacturers or their authorized suppliers/channel partners involved in supply of Paper/Copier papers for a minimum of 5 years are eligible to participate in this tender. Experience will be counted as on last date for submission of bids against this tender. The Notebook convertors with the required infrastructure will also be treated as traders and are required to produce an authorization letter from the manufacturer.

The Manufacturer of Paper must be of A Grade with integrated pulp and paper mills having a minimum annual production capacity of 2,50,000 MTs per annum. Declaration from the OEM must be uploaded in this regard.
The Bidder must agree for supply of Copier papers under the brand name of Lekhak or any other brand of MSIL.
The bidding company should be a profit-making company for the last 3 financial years
The Bidder should furnish two Reams of samples of each variety on or before the date of opening of the technical bid.
The manufacturer must be ISO certified under relevant clause
The Bidder should not have been blacklisted by Govt. of any state of India or Govt. of India.
The applicant firm/Company must have a valid GST registration and must have filed up to date GST returns without any default

The Bidder should have achieved an average annual turnover of at least Rs. 5 Crore in supply of Paper/Copier paper during the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). In case if accounts finalization is not done yet for FY 2025-26, provisional statements or turnover certificate issued by CA will be considered.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss statements for the last three financial years
CA certified turnover certificate for the last three financial years
Certificate of registration issued by the Competent Govt. Authority.
Copies of Income tax returns for the last three financial years
Copy of PAN and GST registration certificate with latest GST returns copy
Declaration in Format -3 on Rs. 500/- stamp paper declaring that the bidder is not block listed by any Govt. Dept. during last 5 years
Details of plant and machineries and production capacity of the original manufacturer in a separate sheet
Duly filled Format -2 on letter head of the bidder
If the authorized supplier/channel partner of the manufacturer is participating in the bid, then the authorization letter from the manufacturer clearly indicating the tender number must be uploaded
Partnership deed/articles of association if applicable
Undertaking in Format -1 on the letter head of the manufacturer/bidder agreeing to supply Copier papers under Lekhak or any other brand owned by MSIL
Valid Work Orders and respective invoice copies for supply of Paper/Copier papers executed during last 3 financial years
